data.body:
Investigation 2026-10-24 (read-only; temporary probe files removed, no code changed). The ticket's mechanism does not hold on current main.

1. The generator no longer mutates sys.path. scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py has no sys.path.insert; the line was removed by commit 1b8c50e3c23 (Move the reconciler to rebar.reconciler). Run under the ticket's order, sys.path[:4] is identical with and without the hardening module.
2. The hardening module is not needed. The failure still reproduces with a one-line stub test in tests/unit/reconciler/ (3 failed), and with tests/unit/reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_snapshot.py in its place (3 failed). It does not reproduce with the outside test and the fetcher alone, or with the hardening module and the fetcher alone.
3. Observed cause of the symptom: in the failing order the fetcher tests are set up WITHOUT the autouse fixtures from tests/unit/reconciler/conftest.py (_default_jira_project, _sandbox_repo_root; checked with --setup-show). JIRA_PROJECT is therefore unset, compose_config() returns jira.project '', and fetcher.jql_active raises the ValueError in the ticket. Every other autouse fixture, including tests/conftest.py and tests/unit/conftest.py, still ran.
4. Trigger: explicit pytest path arguments in the order [file in reconciler/, file outside reconciler/, file in reconciler/fetch/]. A bare pytest 9.1.1 project with no rebar code reproduces it: pkg/conftest.py autouse fixture, then args pkg/test_a.py test_outside.py pkg/sub/test_sub.py gives 1 failed, 2 passed; dropping test_a.py, or passing the pkg directory, gives all passed.
5. The CI claim does not hold. Fixture sets are fixed at collection time, so worksteal execution order cannot change them. make test's collection (-n 4 --dist worksteal over tests/unit, default order) with the three files selected passed 19/19 on 3 of 3 runs.

Upstream: no matching pytest issue found (gh search, 5 phrasings, returned nothing; the one candidate, pytest-dev/pytest#7777 on package collection design, does not cover it). Not filed upstream. The practical rule for running a subset locally: pass one directory, or list the reconciler/ paths together rather than interleaving outside files.
